action: A duckling standing in place turns its head from a left-facing profile to look down and to its right, as if preening its chest, then holds the head-down pose.
identity_gap: Construction and stroke habit: the doodle is a side-profile duck drawn as one closed outline of straight polyline segments with stick legs and open triangle feet; the cartoon is a front-facing duckling with smooth curved contours, separate wing shapes, teardrop chest marks and drawn webbed feet, so none of the doodle's angular profile build carries over.
notes: Frame 1 to 2 jumps from profile head straight to a downturned three-quarter head with no in-between, and frames 7-8 lose the head's left outline so the head reads as fragments. A faint ghost of the frame 1 pose stays visible in every frame, which adds to the clutter.
